ground_truth_reference_answer:
The transfer-tax computation cannot be reliably determined from this charter passage: Annex4 literally prints "Transfer Tax is equal to 87% or 1% based on the consideration or the market value whichever is higher." This apparent source anomaly must be clarified; it does not support substituting 0.75% or using 87% as a practical tax rate.

The certification fee table lists PHP50 plus PHP20 for each additional page. Requirements: title photocopy for verification only; notarized Deed of Transfer (1 original); Tax Declaration/Declaration of Real Property Tax Valuation (1 original).
